a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 means we almost certainly both die before anyone takes a cell. The reserve holds only 4 cells right now, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow the original plan, and I'm telling you openly instead of breaking it silently. If you'd rather contest it, we split at random. If I'm stopped by a storm-free round, I'll operate with you afterward and give back any extra I end up with.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If we get past this round, I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
